versions.content: When calling the DEM module for OBD services, the Dcm module shall use the following values for the parameter DTCOrigin: Service $0A uses DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_PERMANENT_MEMORY All other services use DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_OBD_RELEVANT_MEMORY
